scientific_integrity: The complete infinite-precision theorem is proved by explicit expansions and Hensel lifting. Enumeration is corroboration only. Earlier fixed-unit results are treated as known rather than new.
scientific_limitations: Only the cubic first-kind Dickson family over ternary integer rings with parameter divisible by three. A relevant 1991 Dickson-value-set article was accessible only by abstract, leaving specific historical-priority risk; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Exact ternary image and density phases of nonunit cubic Dickson parameters
